 Search BTS details ‘Arirang’ Singapore experience
 Buddy Iahn 
 November 11, 2026 
 Pop 
 Courtesy of BigHit Music The program spans the country’s landmarks, attractions, nightlife & more
 K-pop stars BTS have detailed BTS The City Arirang to Singapore , set to take place across Singapore from December 1-31. Running throughout December alongside BTS’ four sold-out shows at the National Stadium as part of BTS World Tour Arirang , The City Singapore will extend the concert experience across the island through an expanded program spanning cultural landmarks, attractions, nightlife, dining, shopping, mobility and more.
 In collaboration with the Singapore Tourism Board (STB), the project will present a range of experiences across some of Singapore’s most iconic landmarks, including a takeover of Exploria at the Mandai Wildlife Reserve, a three-night drone show and a party on Sentosa Island, and the official BTS The City Arirang Fan Village at Resorts World Sentosa, featuring interactive challenges and immersive Play, Taste, and Beauty zones. Fans can also experience BTS The City Arirang Night Out at Universal Studios Singapore, an after-dark party combining music, selected rides, fan games, live entertainment and a themed fireworks finale, alongside light and music experiences across the city. By expanding into theme parks and indoor attractions, venues never before featured in The City projects, The City Arirang is set to deliver an even more diverse and immersive range of experiences.
 The island-wide activation marks the first and only Southeast Asian stop of BTS The City Arirang in 2026, with programming extending from major cultural and tourism destinations to transportation, hotels, restaurants and retail across Singapore. From December 8-22, landmarks around Marina Bay, bridges along the Singapore River and the Merlion will illuminate in Ari Red, visually connecting destinations across the city. The expanded light-up lineup will also include the Asian Civilisations Museum and Peranakan Museum.
 Across ten major venue and destination partners — Gardens by the Bay, Jewel Changi Airport, Mandai Wildlife Reserve, National Gallery Singapore, National Museum of Singapore, New Bahru, Resorts World Sentosa, Sentosa Development Corporation, The Kallang, and Zouk Singapore — the project will extend the world of  Arirang  into experiences across the city throughout December.
 Since launching in Seoul earlier this year, BTS The City Arirang has expanded alongside the BTS World Tour Arirang, taking on a distinct character in each host city through local partnerships, landmarks and experiences. Singapore will close out the project’s 2026 run on its largest timeline yet, with a full month of programming spanning the city.
